product.name: PRAXIS
product.purpose: Turn a real situation into one defensible move, or refuse to manufacture strategy.

scope.rationale: The user explicitly requested that the complete closed loop ship in one implementation with no deferred product items.

books: Getting to Yes — Roger Fisher, William Ury, Bruce Patton
corpus.rationale: The set spans social influence, decision quality, and principled negotiation without pretending one tradition covers every situation.

inference.rationale: Terra balances intelligence and cost; low reasoning effort favors a fast, phone-at-the-desk interaction.

runtime.stack: React + Vite + TypeScript client, Express + TypeScript server
runtime.target: local computer and phone on the same trusted network
runtime.persistence: atomic local JSON state under PRAXIS_DATA_DIR
runtime.credentials: OPENAI_API_KEY and PRAXIS_ACCESS_TOKEN are read by the server only
runtime.external_adapters: local graph and passage stores work out of the box; Neo4j and Chroma HTTP adapters activate when their environment variables are configured

evidence_policy.source_precision: chapter or named section for seed cards; ingested passages retain user-supplied source labels; no invented page numbers or quotations

closed_loop.decision_write: Every non-question result is recorded locally.
closed_loop.resolution: The user marks a prediction hit or miss and can add outcome notes.
closed_loop.personal_weight: Bayesian-smoothed hit rate demotes weak cards during ranking without overriding dead-card exclusion.
closed_loop.audit: Coverage, unresolved decisions, per-card hit rates, and never-fired cards are calculated on demand.
closed_loop.rep: Synthetic practice targets the least-used or weakest-performing eligible card.
